title: Conn Lab status
description: Public, credential-free facts about whether this server serves Conn Lab and can sign browsers in. It names missing settings, never their values.

lab_built.description: False when conn server was built without the web assets; the API still works.

missing_settings.description: Server settings that browser sign-in still needs. Empty when sign-in is available.

lab_url.description: The origin users open, from CONN_PUBLIC_URL, when it is configured.
